verdict.rationale: Anytype's Web Publishing feature lets users pick any Object and click Publish to generate a static HTML page on a personal subdomain (.any.org), including custom icon/cover, directly from within the app — matching the digital-garden use case with working links via the app's native linking/backlinking system. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of link-following behavior between published pages or customization depth, and no evidence on bulk/multi-page publishing workflows.
